description: The ArtifactInfoFactory.java class is responsible for managing and providing access to various artifact information objects within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles entities, services, forms, screens, controller requests, and views, including loading, caching, and analysis of related components. The class also facilitates retrieving metadata about these artifacts and supports traversal of their interrelations.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for managing artifact information objects such as entities, services, forms, screens, and controls within the OFBiz framework. Implements caching, loading, and analysis functionalities, and provides various accessor methods to retrieve metadata and interrelations among artifacts.

methods.name: getArtifactInfoFactory
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton instance of ArtifactInfoFactory for a given delegator name, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: prepareAll
methods.description: Loads and initializes all artifact info objects, including entities, services, screens, forms, and controllers, using concurrent execution.

methods.name: getEntityModelReader
methods.description: Returns the ModelReader used to access entity models.

methods.name: getDispatchContext
methods.description: Returns the DispatchContext instance associated with this factory.

methods.name: getModelEntity
methods.description: Fetches the ModelEntity for a given entity name from the entity model reader.

methods.name: getModelService
methods.description: Fetches the ModelService for a given service name from the dispatch context.

methods.name: getModelForm
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelForm given form location and name, optionally parsing form identifier string.

methods.name: getModelScreen
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelScreen given screen location and name.

methods.name: getControllerRequestMap
methods.description: Returns the request mapping configuration for a controller URL and URI.

methods.name: getControllerViewMap
methods.description: Returns the view mapping configuration for a controller URL and view URI.

methods.name: getEntityArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the EntityArtifactInfo object for a specified entity, creating and populating it if necessary.

methods.name: getServiceArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the ServiceArtifactInfo object for a specified service, creating and populating it if necessary.

methods.name: getServiceEcaArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the ServiceEcaArtifactInfo for a given ECA rule, creating and populating if needed.

methods.name: getFormWidgetArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the FormWidgetArtifactInfo for a form specified by name and location.

methods.name: getScreenWidgetArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the ScreenWidgetArtifactInfo for a screen specified by name and location.

methods.name: getControllerRequestArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the ControllerRequestArtifactInfo for a URL and request URI.

methods.name: getControllerViewArtifactInfo
methods.description: Returns the ControllerViewArtifactInfo for a URL and view URI.

methods.name: getArtifactInfoByUniqueIdAndType
methods.description: Retrieves an artifact info object based on its unique ID and type.

methods.name: getArtifactInfoByNameAndType
methods.description: Retrieves an artifact info object by name, location, and type.

methods.name: getAllArtifactInfosByNamePartial
methods.description: Returns a set of artifact info objects whose names contain a given partial string, filtered by type.
